articles.title: The Dodo Wasn't Dumb! Its Secret Super-Senses Revealed
articles.summary: Scientists used super-detailed scans of the only two complete dodo skulls in the world and found clues that the dodo had a great sense of smell and touch. It might have been active at dawn and dusk, not just daytime.

articles.title: 60,000-Year-Old Eggshell Art Shows Humans Were Math Whizzes!
articles.summary: Ancient people carved careful patterns on ostrich eggshells 60,000 years ago. Scientists found that over 80% of the lines follow rules like parallel lines and right angles, showing early humans thought in a geometric, organized way.

articles.title: A Satellite That 'Breathes' Air to Zoom Around Earth? Yes, Really!
articles.summary: A Spanish company plans to launch the first satellite that uses air from Earth's atmosphere as fuel. It scoops up air, heats it, and shoots it out to move. This could let satellites fly super low for better pictures and internet.
